text:
Situation: Clonazepam tablets remain in shortage per FDA records first posted 2023-03-10 and current as of 2026-10-21. Affected companies include Accord Healthcare Inc., Aurobindo Pharma USA, Cheplapharm Arzneimittel GmbH, Prinston Pharmaceutical Inc., Rubicon Research Private Limited, and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. Corvale General holds 246 tablets of the 1 mg presentation with 31.3 days on hand at current use.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1195651 at Rubicon Research Limited (FEI 3008252295), the plant named on Northstar Rx LLC's label, ended 2023-01-27 and was classified VAI with the classification letter dated 2023-03-14 — 42 days before the shortage posting. An earlier inspection 828916 at the same plant in 2013 was also classified VAI. The plant's most recent inspection was NAI on 2024-03-08.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately one month of supply. The rule-identified best option is purchasing from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as secondary source — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate AvPAK as tertiary source — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Chartwell RX, LLC as quaternary source — requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate Clinical Solutions Wholesale, LLC as fifth source — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending resolution of the existing shortage listings.
